notes:
- 修复「已改写」被误判回「验证中」，诊断结论更稳
- 修复主动停止后再打开 App 会被自动开启的残留路径
- 修复冷启动时模块坐标丢失后补不回来
- 诊断页在第三方模式下自动刷新，不再空着
- 收藏页行高对齐新版系统，列表不再挤成一团
- 旧系统页面圆角抬到 26pt，接近 iOS 26 观感
- 图层胶囊收窄到与浮标同宽；三颗浮标可点范围扩大约 78%
notesEn:
- Fixed: a confirmed rewrite could be pushed back to verifying
- Fixed: stopping spoofing then reopening the app could re-enable it
- Fixed: cold start with lost module coordinates could never restore them
- Diagnostics now auto-refreshes in third-party mode instead of staying empty
- Favorites rows now match newer iOS height, no more cramped list
- Sheet corner radius raised to 26pt on older iOS
- Layer capsule narrowed to button width; floating buttons hit area +78%
